citation.authors: Della Porta M, Maier JA, Cazzola R

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: Stressed adults in 9 clinical trials (country and ethnicity not stated in the abstract)
record.design: Systematic review of trials of Withania somnifera and cortisol, from 4,788 records screened, trials lasting 30 to 112 days
record.finding: Supplementation decreased cortisol with no significant adverse effects. The studies differed in design, dose and duration. None looked at the effect of lowering cortisol on adrenal function or at long-term effects.
record.note: No pooled figure in the abstract. Short trials. Ethnicity not reported.
